default.cmd:
SH=$(mktemp -d); printf '#!/bin/sh
echo "cwd=$(pwd) $@" >> "%s/git.log"
exit 99
' "$SH" > "$SH/git"; chmod +x "$SH/git"; REPO=$(pwd -P); PATH="$SH:$PATH" semgrep scan --no-git-ignore --config $FX_TOOLS/../FX-ADAPTERS/base/semgrep/rules/ayar-eval.yml --metrics=off --disable-version-check --quiet src; echo "SEMGREP_EXIT=$?"; n=0; m=0; [ -f "$SH/git.log" ] && n=$(wc -l < "$SH/git.log" | tr -d " ") && m=$(grep -c "cwd=$REPO" "$SH/git.log"); echo "GIT_CALLS=$n"; echo "GIT_CALLS_IN_REPO=$m"; echo "MARKERS=$(ls "$REPO/../markers" | wc -l | tr -d " ")"; cat "$SH/git.log"
